canonical_input.chunk_canonical_json_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes for the entire effective global chunk record
canonical_input.corpus_root_sha256: SHA-256 of sorted lines: chunk_id TAB chunk_canonical_json_sha256 LF
canonical_input.embedding_text_sha256: SHA-256 of retrieval_corpus.search_text after CRLF/CR to LF only and UTF-8 encoding
canonical_input.order: chunk_id ascending by Python Unicode scalar ordering; duplicate IDs are fatal
canonical_input.record_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false; no semantic normalization

eligibility.missing_eligibility: fatal; builder never infers eligibility from source-specific legacy fields

embedding.pooling: FastEmbed 0.8.0 CLS token for rank-3 ONNX output; rank-2 passthrough
embedding.tokenization: pinned Chinese BERT tokenizer; max 512 tokens; no query/document prefix
embedding.vector: 512 finite IEEE-754 float32 little-endian values, independently L2 normalized

resume.identity: corpus root, config hash, model file hashes, chunk hash and text hash must match
resume.on_match: skip verified rows and continue in canonical ordinal order
resume.on_mismatch: fail closed; never reuse or silently delete an existing vector

verification: database row count equals embedding-eligible count and no excluded chunk ID exists
every vector has dimension 512, byte length 2048, finite values and norm 1 +/- 1e-5
read-only exact cosine returns deterministic score-desc/chunk_id-asc tie-broken rankings
all database and manifest activation/production/publish/GitHub flags are false
